answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 12085 Country: India Title: as salaam muftisaheb my finance is very poor so please give me dua or zikhar for me and please do dua for me thankh you! Question: as salaam muftisaheb my finance is very poor so please give me dua or zikhar for me and please do dua for me thankh you! Answer ID: 12085 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 602/602=M/1430) Recite ya Mughni ( یا مغن ي ) after Isha Salah 1100 times with durood 11 times before and after. It is a useful dua for prosperity and expansion in livelihood resources. Your fiancé should recite it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
